questions.q: Why is analog at the edge of range safer than a digital system with compression?
options: Analog has noticeably more range at the same power
The picture gets noisy but does not freeze
Analog is not affected by obstacles and reflections
Analog keeps a higher frame rate at the edge
questions.explain: Analog degrades gradually; digital holds a clean picture up to a threshold, then freezes or breaks up.

questions.q: Why do you have to measure a digital system's latency yourself?
options: Manufacturers do not state it at all
It depends on the mode and the link quality
It cannot be measured without recording goggles
It is the same for every system of one class
questions.explain: The stated figure is the minimum in the best mode; at the edge the bitrate and frame rate drop and latency grows.

questions.q: Where do compression blocks appear first?
options: On a static scene while hovering in place
On a fast pass over grass
Flying into the sun at sunset
At low height over smooth asphalt
questions.explain: Inter-frame compression works worst when neighboring frames are least alike: a finely detailed scene in motion.

questions.q: How does the HD OSD get into a digital system's goggles?
options: The flight controller overlays it on the video signal itself
Over MSP DisplayPort; the goggles draw it
The OSD reaches the goggles through the ELRS receiver
Through a separate video input on the air unit's camera
questions.explain: The flight controller sends what to draw; the drawing happens on the digital system's side.

questions.q: Which parameters enable HD OSD in ArduPilot?
options: SERIALn_PROTOCOL = 42 and OSD_TYPE = 5
SERIALn_PROTOCOL = 2 and OSD_TYPE = 1
OSD_TYPE = 3 together with VTX_ENABLE = 1
SERIALn_PROTOCOL = 33 and OSD_TYPE = 2
questions.explain: Protocol 42 is DisplayPort on the port; OSD_TYPE 5 is MSP_DISPLAYPORT.

questions.q: What sets HDZero apart from compressed digital systems?
options: It is analog with a digital OSD on top
No inter-frame compression, stable latency
It works only in the 2.4 GHz band
It has the best sharpness of all systems
questions.explain: Frame-synchronous transmission without inter-frame compression: predictable latency at the cost of sharpness.

questions.q: Why would an autopilot aircraft use OpenIPC + WFB-ng?
options: It has the lowest latency of all systems
Openness and MAVLink in the same link
It needs no antennas on the air unit
It works without any frequency rules
questions.explain: Open firmware and a telemetry tunnel; latency is higher than in FPV systems, and you build it by hand.

questions.q: Analog and digital fly at the same field, and a neighbor gets interference. The first thing to do?
options: Raise your VTX power to the maximum
Agree on channels, lower the power
Swap the antennas for directional patches
Turn off video recording in your goggles
questions.explain: Digital channels are wider; a frequency plan and power on the ground solve most conflicts.
